thread:
sara_p: Quick sync — SOC2 v2 launch gating. Need final decision on three items: audit log export SLA, BYOK (user-managed KMS) as beta or GA, and retention tiering + pricing. Who's on?

devon_pm: On it. I pulled the last customer asks list; several enterprise customers want BYOK at GA and 7+ years retention options.

julie_security: Re: BYOK — we need clear STO (scope, threat model, ops) doc before GA. Can we keep BYOK as Dedicated-only GA and Hosted beta?

aj_m: Dedicated-only GA sounds safe. If Hosted beta, we need automated key handshake + telemetry toggles to avoid data leakage risks.

maria_eng: For audit logs: can we commit to an export SLA of 48 hours for full-archive exports and streaming/nearline for recent 30 days? That's what infra can support cheaply.

nate_fin: 48h export SLA seems fine, but long-term storage costs explode with 7+ years — propose tiered billing: standard(90d) included, extended(1-3y) +, archival(>3y) cost recovery.

sara_p: Sounds reasonable. We need acceptance criteria to match those options for the launch checklist. Let's draft minimal gating: 1) BYOK handshake spec published; 2) Audit export CLI + API with sample ndjson; 3) Retention tiers documented + pricing.

aj_m: I'll drop a handshake RFC. Short checklist: key rotation/rollover; KMS permission model; fallback path (no keys) that preserves availability.

julie_security: Also: audit trail for key access ops and KMS-proxied logs (for legal/evidence). That must be searchable for SOC2 auditors.

maria_eng: For the audit export API, propose this CLI example as a minimal contract:

```
# export tenant audit as ndjson, compressed
redwoodctl audit export --tenant t-abc123 --since 2025-01-01 --until 2025-12-31 --format ndjson --compress gzip 
```

maria_eng: The API will stream and produce continuations for large exports. We'll support incremental checkpoints so retries resume quickly.

devon_pm: UX acceptance: product needs a console flow that shows export status, estimated size/cost, and a toggle to include PII redaction. Also BYOK onboarding flow with clear warnings. Can devex design help?

sara_p: @maria_eng can you estimate infra work and rollout phasing? We want hosted beta -> dedicated GA -> private (VPC) GA.

maria_eng: Rough estimate: audit export + retention policy enforcement ~3 sprints; BYOK handshake + KMS integration ~4-5 sprints; UI/UX + pricing docs ~2 sprints. Rollout: alpha customers in sprint 4, hosted beta in sprint 6, dedicated GA in sprint 10.

nate_fin: I'll model cost tiers and a break-even for archival options, send spreadsheet. Need engineering cost per TB-month and expected access frequency.

aj_m: One more technical constraint: prefix KV caching for tokens should be compatible with BYOK — ensure cache keys don't leak tenant secrets. Adding handshake header to requests is simplest.

julie_security: Add auditing acceptance criteria: every BYOK operation (key creation, rotation, access) must emit a structured audit event; retention and export actions recorded with actor and justification.

ops_bot: Reminder: deployment window for GA changes is scheduled next quarter. Please tag PRs with #soc2-v2 and include migration guide. :calendar:

devon_pm: OK — action items: (1) AJ RFC by Fri; (2) Maria infra estimate by Mon; (3) Julie to write auditing acceptance list; (4) Nate to send pricing model. We'll reconvene Tue to final-scope and ship launch checklist. :thumbsup:
